run_train_videoseal: run the videoseal training pipeline with torchrun using configurable embedder, extractor, and augmentation parameters
run_video_finetuning: run video finetuning of the videoseal model by resuming from a pretrained checkpoint with frozen embedder
run_eval_only: run evaluation only on validation datasets without training using torchrun and --only_eval flag
build_videoseal_model: build the complete videoseal model with embedder, extractor, augmenter, and attenuation modules
configure_loss_optimizers: configure the videoseal loss function with discriminator, perceptual loss, and dual optimizers for generator and detector
